title: How Marc Lou gets free customers with Product Hunt launches
summary: Marc Lou explains how he used Product Hunt (21 launches, 13 awards) as a free traffic channel. He covers how daily ranking works, how to win inbound votes with name, tagline, logo, images and a founder story, how to pull outbound votes from Twitter, users and badges, and when to launch.

principles.text: The first four hours of a Product Hunt launch matter most, so focus on winning votes then.
principles.quote: that's why the first four hours are the most important and in this video we're going to cover how to get the most up votes during this time

principles.text: Write a short tagline about what the product does for customers, not about the product itself.
principles.quote: it shouldn't be about your product but it should be about what it's doing for your customers uh what pain is it relieving how their life would be after they try your product

principles.text: Prefer simple, logical product names over VC-style brand names, and use a logo that contrasts with the crowd.
principles.quote: you would rather ditch uh like VC style names like stripe or Tesla and go for something very logic IAL like ship fast a tool to ship fast

principles.text: Open with your personal founder story in the first comment, because people relate to people.
principles.quote: people relate with people and stories you are not a VC back company with millions of dollars for marketing who just want to make even more money you are a nice person

principles.text: Build an audience by launching products; that audience then boosts each later launch in a loop.
principles.quote: an audience is not created out of thin air people follow you for a reason and that reason is because you might be the guy who launched a bunch of products on product hunt

principles.text: Launch on other platforms the same day and add a Product Hunt badge to your site to funnel extra votes.
principles.quote: I scheduled the product hunt launch and I would launch on every other platform so it brings an extra juice to product hunt
